description: Per-distribution attestation. G9 STRUCTURAL: communityDiscernmentAttestations minLength 3 + councilAttestations minLength 3 (Council Lv6+ ≥3 + ≥3 community attestation chain; NOT claim adjudication). G7 STRUCTURAL: noPreExistingConditionExclusion const true. G3 NOT insurance: needCategory enum is discernment-based, NOT claim-category-based.

recipientPseudonymDid.description: 30-day rotating pseudonym DID per ADR-2605181200; member privacy preserved in distribution

needAttestationCid.description: Encrypted need attestation CID (member-submitted OR community-member-on-behalf-with-consent)

needCategory.description: G3 NOT insurance: discernment-based need category, NOT claim-category

communityDiscernmentAttestations.description: G9 STRUCTURAL: ≥3 community members attesting need (witness chain; NOT claim verification)

councilAttestations.description: G9 STRUCTURAL: ≥3 Council Lv6+ DIDs discerning distribution

noPreExistingConditionExclusion.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const true; no underwriting; no exclusion; no risk-based rejection

claimAdjudicated.description: G3 NOT insurance: const false; distribution is discernment, NOT claim adjudication

distributionAmountEncryptedCid.description: ADR-2605181100 encrypted envelope CID (member privacy; aggregate only public)

crossActorEventCid.description: Cross-link to iyashi/hagukumi/yakushi/kazaori event CID (when applicable)

publicFundBackstopRequestCid.description: If distribution required Public Fund backstop, the publicFundBackstopRequest CID
